maddeler.e:
تلتحقي (form VIII)
# تَلْتَحِقِي (taltaḥiqī) /tal.ta.ħi.qiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِلْتَحَقَ (iltaḥaqa)
# تُلْتَحَقِي (tultaḥaqī) /tul.ta.ħa.qiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِلْتَحَقَ (iltaḥaqa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
